programs.title: Unobvious places
programs.desc: There is an energy-saving house by Justyna and Piotr in Smolniki, Greater Poland.The building, located in the middle of the forest, has direct access to the lake and is equipped with solar panels that give the owners independence.Joanna and Artur, parents of three children, moved into the house from a two-room apartment.Their priority was low electricity bills.Thanks to the use of modern solutions, life for a family of five does not generate high costs.Marcin, a sailing enthusiast, built a floating house that is moored on Lake Charzykowskie.The nature surrounding the building influenced the energy-saving solutions used in it.

programs.title: Unobvious places
programs.desc: Katarzyna Jaroszyńska visits unusual houses, located in charming natural surroundings.The host will watch, among others:Dutch houses, barges, trailers, and houses made of containers.

programs.title: A journey into the unknown: Following the Yeti
programs.desc: Josh Gates sets out to find the yeti, the legendary half-man, half-ape that lives high in the Himalayas.During this expedition, the traveler talks to world-famous researchers.

programs.title: Asian Times
programs.desc: Julian Hanton visits Asia.It checks what changes are taking place on the continent, where economic recovery goes hand in hand with population growth.The leader begins his journey in Hong Kong, where he inadvertently agrees to take a punch from Bruce Lee.This experience will be remembered for a long time.In Thailand, he makes friends with investigative journalists, becomes a secret agent and monitors local gambling.In the Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia and China, he carefully observes people and their behavior.He discovers that all corners of the world are an inexhaustible source of knowledge.

programs.title: Man v Food 2
programs.desc: Adam sets off on a journey across the United States to take part in subsequent rounds of timed eating competitions.Adam will take on Badass Burrito in Las Vegas and a 106-centimetre pizza in San Antonio.

programs.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programs.desc: Las Vegas, known as America's playground, attracts crowds of tourists eager for entertainment and nightlife.This city full of neon lights, casinos and concerts is also a place where many people find employment.Marcin Prokop goes to Nevada to look at the lives of employees behind the scenes.He meets Nicole, whose dream is to become an erotic dancer in one of the clubs.After her stay in Barcelona, ​​she returns to Las Vegas to start her career.The host also talks to Internet creator Steve, who describes everyday life in the city and the threats that may await people here.
